record.paper: Halfway to induced saturation for even cycles

dossier_meta.paper: Halfway to induced saturation for even cycles
dossier_meta.statement_text: Let $t\geq 6$ be an integer. Does there exist a graph $G$ with $E(\overline{G})\neq\varnothing$ such that $G$ is $H$-free but $G+e$ has an induced subgraph isomorphic to $C_{2t-2}$ for every $e\in E(\overline{G})$?
dossier_meta.context_text: The authors prove Theorem 1.6 constructing graphs that are $C_{2t}$-free but where removing any edge creates an induced copy of $C_{2t}$ (half of the induced saturation condition). Question 1.7 asks about the other half: whether the edge-addition condition can also be satisfied, which would be a key step toward solving the induced saturation problem for all even cycles.
